title: Build quick setups inside the app
note: No guide: one-tap setups in Settings instead (Morning, Never miss a start, Work in stretches). Spec written, coding thread requested. No medical wording.
details: A Quick setups row at the top of Settings. Each setup applies existing settings in one tap, shows what changed and can be undone. Store Reel and screenshot wording stays free of medical claims. Larger ideas (first-run choice, settings search, focus block) wait until after the 4 Dec release.
